behaviour: The shared command stripping keeps the command substitutions bash runs inside an unquoted heredoc body, plain or dash tab indented, written with a dollar parenthesis or backticks, each on a line of its own with any heredoc inside it cut the same way, so branch guard refuses a direct push to main written as such a substitution. A single quoted delimiter body, escaped substitution text and process substitution text, which bash never runs in a body, stay data and are cut.
